incident.location_text: Housing society gate, Lokhandwala, Andheri West
incident.narrative: As I turned slowly into my housing society compound in Lokhandwala, an electric kick-scooter rider cut across in front of me. I swerved to avoid him and hit the concrete gate pillar with the front right corner of the car. He jumped off and was not hurt; his scooter fell and is lying in front of my car. The front bumper is torn, the right headlamp is broken and the bonnet is dented.
